entries.nameEn: Formation of a zinc–copper galvanic cell

goal.zh: 区分局部析氢、外电流及电解质离子通路。
goal.en: Distinguish local hydrogen evolution, external current and ionic charge transport.

entries.nameEn: Designing and constructing simple cells

goal.zh: 比较水果和湿纸中的离子通路、材料条件及串联负载能力。
goal.en: Compare electrolyte routes, material conditions and loaded series cells.

entries.nameEn: Converting chemical energy into electrical energy

goal.zh: 用无电解质和不同电极材料对照判断原电池构成。
goal.en: Use missing-electrolyte and electrode-material controls to identify cell requirements.

entries.nameEn: A zinc–copper galvanic cell with a salt bridge

goal.zh: 对应金属变化、盐桥离子方向与实际液体接触。
goal.en: Connect metal changes, bridge-ion directions and actual liquid contact.

entries.nameEn: Constructing a simple fuel cell

goal.zh: 区分外电源电解、断开与有限气体原电池放电。
goal.en: Distinguish powered electrolysis, isolation and finite-gas galvanic discharge.

entries.nameEn: Factors affecting reaction rates

goal.zh: 在固定其他条件时比较温度与浓度的影响，区分速率与总产量。
goal.en: Compare temperature and concentration under controlled conditions, separating rate from total yield.

entries.nameEn: Factors influencing reaction rates

goal.zh: 对照浓度、温度和催化剂，记录同一观察标准下的变化。
goal.en: Control concentration, temperature and catalyst comparisons with a shared observation criterion.

entries.nameEn: Qualitative and quantitative study of reaction-rate factors

goal.zh: 从对照设计过渡到同一气体体积终点计时，并检查漏气与读数口径。
goal.en: Connect controlled design to timing a common gas endpoint, checking leaks and the meaning of the measured rate.

entries.nameEn: Effective collisions, activation energy and catalysts

goal.zh: 追踪原子身份，说明碰撞条件及催化路径的相同能量终点。
goal.en: Track atom identities through collision conditions and compare catalytic pathways with shared energy endpoints.

entries.nameEn: Formation of dynamic chemical equilibrium

goal.zh: 比较相同原子总量的两种起点，理解平衡时双向反应仍继续。
goal.en: Compare two starting compositions with equal atom totals and retain both nonzero reaction directions at equilibrium.

entries.nameEn: Pressure effects on the NO2–N2O4 equilibrium

goal.zh: 分开体积突变与随后化学反应的颜色效应。
goal.en: Separate the immediate color effect of volume change from subsequent chemical relaxation.

entries.nameEn: Temperature effects on the NO2–N2O4 equilibrium

goal.zh: 在封闭、相同装量的气体中比较冷热条件。
goal.en: Compare hot and cold conditions in sealed equally loaded gas samples.

entries.nameEn: Controlling conditions for ammonia synthesis

goal.zh: 用教材平衡数据和独立标示的时间模型比较温度、压强与催化影响。
goal.en: Compare temperature, pressure and catalysts using textbook equilibrium data and separately labelled time models.

entries.nameEn: Investigating factors that shift chemical equilibrium

goal.zh: 完整比较铁盐加料和铁粉、铬酸碱、铜盐冷热及同瓶气体换浴。
goal.en: Compare iron additions and powder, chromium acid–base shifts, copper heating/cooling and identified gas-flask bath exchange.

entries.nameEn: Comparing ionization of hydrochloric and acetic acids

goal.zh: 用同浓度 pH、电导和产气比较电离，并区分电离比例与离子浓度。
goal.en: Compare equal-concentration pH, conductance and gas production, distinguishing ionized fraction from ion concentration.

entries.chapterEn: Ionic reactions and equilibria in aqueous solutions

entries.nameEn: Comparing acidity with acetic acid and sodium carbonate

goal.zh: 观察碳酸钠逐滴加入醋酸后的产气，并限定酸性证据的含义。
goal.en: Observe gas after carbonate enters acetic acid and bound what the acidity evidence establishes.

entries.chapterEn: Ionic reactions and equilibria in aqueous solutions

entries.nameEn: Comparing pressure curves for magnesium with hydrochloric and acetic acids

goal.zh: 区分注入效应、反应速率和酸总量，以教材用量解释共同产氢终点。
goal.en: Separate injection effects, reaction rate and total acid to explain the common yield using textbook quantities.

entries.chapterEn: Ionic reactions and equilibria in aqueous solutions

entries.nameEn: Strong acid–base titration curves and endpoints

goal.zh: 连接加入体积、pH 突变与指示剂变色范围，区分终点和当量点。
goal.en: Connect added volume, steep pH change and indicator ranges, distinguishing endpoint from equivalence.

entries.chapterEn: Ionic reactions and equilibria in aqueous solutions

entries.nameEn: Neutralization titration of a strong acid and a strong base

goal.zh: 完整观察准备、取样、半滴、读数、三次记录和误差，并绘制反向滴定曲线。
goal.en: Follow preparation, sampling, partial drops, readings, three records and errors, then plot the reverse-direction curve.

entries.chapterEn: Ionic reactions and equilibria in aqueous solutions

entries.nameEn: Acidity and basicity of salt solutions

goal.zh: 完整比较六种盐，并连接酸碱性与离子平衡。
goal.en: Compare all six salts and connect acidity to ionic equilibria.

entries.chapterEn: Ionic reactions and equilibria in aqueous solutions

entries.nameEn: Reaction-condition effects on ferric-sulfate hydrolysis

goal.zh: 比较温度、稀释、加晶体与加酸，区分水解比例、浓度与总量。
goal.en: Compare temperature, dilution, crystals and acid while distinguishing fraction, concentration and amount.

entries.chapterEn: Ionic reactions and equilibria in aqueous solutions

entries.nameEn: Applications of salt hydrolysis

goal.zh: 覆盖加酸、三组净水、沸水制胶体及冷热去油后倾倒冲洗。
goal.en: Cover acid addition, three clarification samples, boiling-water colloid preparation and draining/rinsing after cold or heated cleaning.

entries.chapterEn: Ionic reactions and equilibria in aqueous solutions

entries.nameEn: Electrolysis of copper chloride

goal.zh: 区分离子与电子载流路径，联系湿试纸证据、电极产物与电量守恒。
goal.en: Distinguish ionic and electronic paths and connect moist-paper evidence, electrode products and charge conservation.

entries.nameEn: Simple copper electroplating

goal.zh: 完整呈现打磨除油除锈清洗、正确电镀、反接和断路置换对照。
goal.en: Cover abrasion, degreasing, rust removal and rinsing, then correct plating, reversal and open-circuit displacement.

entries.nameEn: Oxygen-absorption corrosion and copper-assisted zinc corrosion

goal.zh: 连贯解释耗氧水柱和铜沉积后锌析氢加速。
goal.en: Connect oxygen uptake to the water column and copper deposition to accelerated zinc hydrogen evolution.

entries.nameEn: Sacrificial-anode protection and indicator evidence

goal.zh: 完整比较铁锌连接、铁附近取样检验、裹锌/缠铜凝胶显色与接触条件。
goal.en: Compare connected iron–zinc, iron-region aliquot testing, zinc/copper gel indicators and metallic contact.

entries.nameEn: Designing and investigating an iron-based warmer

goal.zh: 把材料、控制变量、透气包装、热平衡、实测记录及改进处置组织成研究。
goal.en: Organize materials, controlled variables, permeable packaging, energy balance, actual records, improvement and disposal into an investigation.
